rules: No full-blob substring match (token/segment exact + controlled stem)
Deploy/delete action+gate collocation (content verbs, not key prefix alone)
Abstention: require >=2 independent exact supports OR action+gate agreement with >=1 support
If query has deploy/delete action, records lacking that action in content are dropped
Prefer empty recall over weak single-noun hits

known_limit.note: Weak single-cue taste paraphrases may abstain by design
